findings.evidence: Lines 69–73 show the restricted signature. For uniformly positive g, applying hL to t • g for arbitrarily large t > 0 forces L g ≤ 0; applying this to h + ε • 1 and letting ε decrease to zero gives L h ≤ 0.
findings.fix: Remove `hu` and prove the conclusion by scaling uniformly positive functions, then perturbing nonnegative functions by positive constants.
findings.issue: `apply_nonpos_of_forall_uniformlyPositive_lt` unnecessarily requires `u ≤ 0`; any finite upper bound on this cone suffices.

findings.evidence: Lines 65–74 use only nonnegativity of `Finsupp.single i 1` and closure under nonnegative scaling; replacing that vector throughout by any w with hw gives the general result.
findings.fix: Prove the general conclusion `{w : ι →₀ 𝕜} (hw : 0 ≤ w) : 0 ≤ ψ w` first, and specialize it at the Pietsch call site.
findings.issue: `apply_single_nonneg_of_forall_le` restricts its conclusion to basis vectors although the same argument proves positivity on every nonnegative finitely supported function.

summary: Two extracted helpers retain unnecessary restrictions on otherwise general cone arguments.
